parameters.name: ComponentId
parameters.description:
The component ID. Example: nginx-ingress-controller, flexvolume, or metrics-server.

You can call the `DescribeAddons` API operation to query the components supported by the cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs describe-cluster-addon-upgrade-status --cluster-id c106f377e16f34eb1808d6b9362c90000 --component-id cloud-controller-manager --region cn-hangzhou
